products.name: Surfer SEO
products.note: SEO optimization AI; content scoring; NLP analysis; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Surfer is a software company operating at surferseo.com that describes itself as an AI visibility platform aimed at marketing and SEO teams. Its stated focus is helping brands track and improve their presence across both traditional search engines like Google and AI-driven engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. The company describes its offering as an "AI Search Operating System" designed to analyze what drives visibility in both conventional and AI-assisted search, and to surface competitive gaps, content opportunities, and real-time monitoring alerts.

The company's primary product, Surfer SEO, sits in the writing and editing category and combines content scoring, NLP analysis, and AI-assisted writing with optimization guidelines surfaced inside a writing interface. The site describes capabilities including competitor strategy analysis, automated outline and draft generation, programmatic page creation, and ongoing monitoring that flags when a page loses rankings or when an AI engine shifts which brand it cites in a given answer. EU-hosted options are noted as available. One user quoted on the site describes more than doubling blog content production while reducing the cost to produce SEO content by more than four times, characterized as "double the content at a quarter of the price."

The held facts on file confirm Surfer carries a single tracked product under the writing and editing category, with no litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations recorded at this time.
